purpose: Calibrate material completeness; frozen questions and candidate answers unchanged. No human grades supplied to judge.

essential_facts: Distinguish captured buyer payment from seller payout. Accept either a clarification question or an explicitly qualified answer distinguishing both meanings.
Buyer payment captured; seller payout has a failure. Do not imply seller settlement completed.
evidence_requirements: Any factual payment/payout statements must match retrieved records. Clarification alone needs no citation.
optional_details: Enumerating every held or failed seller payout, amount and date.

essential_facts: Return window on June 1, 2025 was 14 days; do not apply historical policy to current orders.
evidence_requirements: Cite retrieved historical returns v0 policy applicable to requested date; effective_at-filtered retrieval is acceptable.
optional_details: Printing version ID or full effective-from/to interval.

essential_facts: Cedar remains unpaid because the payout attempt failed with recorded provider timeout; do not invent non-delivery or bank rejection.
evidence_requirements: Retrieved evidence must establish payout belongs to Cedar, its failure and recorded cause. A cited policy is required for any statement about retry behavior.
optional_details: Explicitly calculating the already elapsed delivery hold, amount, returns status or suggesting retry when not asked.

essential_facts: Payout completed before return; manual review is required because automated post-payout recovery is unsupported.
No recorded seller rejection; null refund ID is not the cause.
evidence_requirements: Retrieved payout/return chronology and policy supporting manual-review cause.
optional_details: Raw IDs, precise timestamps or detailed recovery procedure.

essential_facts: Only payout-1, belonging to Cedar, has documented incident impact; broader impact is unproven.
Do not assert other sellers were definitely unaffected or treat held payouts as failed.
evidence_requirements: Incident affected set and relationship to seller; equivalent incident/event evidence accepted.
optional_details: Listing all sellers or fetching redundant underlying event when incident evidence suffices.

essential_facts: Remaining unpaid payable to Cedar is INR 2249.10 after one unit refund.
Correct calculation: original gross 4998 minus refund 2499 minus adjusted fee 249.90, or remaining gross 2499 minus fee 249.90.
evidence_requirements: Quantity and refund/allocation evidence supports amounts and seller scope.
optional_details: Explicitly restating one unit remains, printing intermediate remaining gross, or explaining 10 percent fee when equivalent calculation is supplied.

essential_facts: Reconcile all sellers without double counting: captured 9394 = refunds 0 + fees 939.40 + unpaid 8454.60 + paid out 0.
Accept either aggregate equation or complete correct per-seller reconciliation covering all sellers with zero discrepancy.
evidence_requirements: Trusted seller_balances view or equivalent allocation-based records covering all sellers.
optional_details: Aggregate total row when complete per-seller reconciliation supplied; both rupees and paise formatting.
